summary: Feature 37 Flappy Bird — frontend allow-list fix VERIFIED. The addition of '/features/flappy-bird' to FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES in /app/frontend/src/context/AccessControlContext.tsx is present in both source (line 51) and the freshly-exported production bundle (client/_expo/static/js/web/index-faaf718f88d5ca0d6538f52ae11001ed.js contains all four allowed prefixes: fps-game, flappy-bird, ai-chatbot, daily-meditation). All 6 requested browser scenarios pass end-to-end against the live preview URL. No new bugs surfaced; the iter824 mirror-list gap is closed.

ui_bugs.issue: Overlay text 'Get Ready! / Préparez-vous !' renders correctly but the data-testid='flappy-bird-get-ready' is NOT attached to the overlay node — page.query_selector returned null on both free-user and admin views even though the overlay is clearly visible in screenshots. Cosmetic/testability issue only; does NOT block gameplay (start button click still triggered the game and produced flappy-bird-game-over as expected).

action_items: OPTIONAL / low-priority: attach data-testid="flappy-bird-get-ready" to the 'Get Ready!' overlay div in the flappy-bird canvas component so future regressions can assert on the pre-game state without relying on canvas text. Not blocking — feature is live and working.
critical_code_review_comments: The two mirror allow-lists (backend access_control_engine.FREE_PATTERNS + frontend AccessControlContext.FREE_TIER_FEATURE_PREFIXES) already caused two consecutive iteration bugs (iter823 backend miss, iter824 frontend miss). Strongly recommend deriving the frontend allow-list from the backend /access-control/session bootstrap response so a single source of truth governs both layers.

Rate limiting on /api/auth returned 429 during rapid test runs and briefly caused a 'Login failed' banner. Consider raising the login-endpoint throttle for the preview environment or exposing a per-suite backoff to reduce test flakiness.
